operation_details.item: The user has a longstanding practice of not eating red meat (beef, pork, lamb) for health reasons.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. I understand you have a formal business banquet coming up. How can I help you prepare?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I'm attending a banquet next week. I need to make sure the menu works for me. I have not eaten red meat since early adulthood as a longstanding personal health choice and do not include beef, pork, or lamb in my diet.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thank you for sharing that. I'll keep that in mind. For the banquet, poultry, fish, or plant-based main courses would be suitable. I recommend confirming with the venue that dishes contain no red meat products or derivatives.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That sounds good. Could you suggest some specific dishes that are typically safe?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly. Grilled salmon, herb-roasted chicken, or a vegetable risotto are excellent choices. Also, consider a mushroom-based main course.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'll look into those. I also need to ensure the appetizers and sides are free of red meat.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely. Many appetizers like shrimp cocktail, bruschetta, or vegetable spring rolls are good options. For sides, roasted vegetables or quinoa salad work well.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's helpful. I'll coordinate with the event planner.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. Also, be cautious with sauces and stocks that might contain beef or pork extracts. You can ask for a detailed ingredient list.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'll definitely do that. Thank you for the advice.
